info.name: Clean365 — Supervisor App
info.description:
# Clean365 Supervisor App API

Folders match the mobile tabs:
1. Auth
2. Home (ops dashboard)
3. Teams
4. Bookings / assigned jobs
5. Profile

Client location always includes `lat` + `lng` in `location` and `coordinates`.
Admin-only actions (create team/task, accept booking) are **not** in this collection.

item.name: 01 — Auth
item.description: Login first. Token is saved to `supervisor_token`.

response.name: 200 Login Success
401 Wrong Password
404 User Not Found
200 Logout
200 Login Success

item.name: 02 — Home
item.description:
Home tab: today summary, team preview, active/upcoming jobs.

`GET /provider/ops/dashboard`

request.description:
Today cards (completed / upcoming / in progress / total %) + teams_preview + active_jobs + upcoming_jobs.
Each job includes `location.text`, `location.lat`, `location.lng`.

item.name: 03 — Teams
item.description:
Teams tab.

| Screen | Endpoint |
|--------|----------|
| Summary + list | `GET /provider/ops/teams` |
| Team follow-up | `GET /provider/ops/teams/{id}` |
| Team CRUD view | `GET /provider/team/` |
| Members | `GET /provider/serviceman/` |

Current job on a team includes `location.lat` / `location.lng`.

request.description:
UI chips: إجمالي / متاح / قيد التنفيذ / في الطريق.
Query: `limit`, `offset`, `status` (`all|available|on_the_way|in_progress|unavailable`), `search`.
Members, attendance, current_job with client location lat/lng.

item.name: 04 — Bookings
item.description:
Assigned jobs tab + job details.

Use **Ops jobs** for the Flutter screens (filters by `field_status`).
Location: `location.text`, `location.lat`, `location.lng` and `coordinates.{lat,lng}`.

request.description:
المهام المسندة. Requires `team_id` on the booking.
Query: `field_status`, `search`, `date`, `limit`, `offset`.
Stepper, team, attendance, customer, location lat/lng, photos, notes, tasks.

Supervisor marks a team member present/absent.

**Body:** `{ "serviceman_id": "...", "is_attended": true, "latitude": 24.83, "longitude": 46.70 }`

Use `accepted` / `ongoing` / `completed` / `all`. Pending is admin-only.
Each item has `location.lat` / `location.lng`.
Lean booking. Team members only (no nested assigned_bookings). Location has lat/lng.
